title: Stats Component
description: Read-only totals, counts and headline values: a row (default), a receipt-like list, or a strip of equal cards. Templates resolve against the store, the enclosing form's values and the component variables (variables win).

name.description: Unique name; also the data-testid of the rendered row

label.description: Caption for the value. String, template or localized map ({ en-US: ... })

value.description: The value, usually a template. An empty value shows an em dash; 0 is shown as 0

unit.description: Shown muted after the value. Hidden when the value is empty

decimals.description: Rounds a numeric value to at most this many fraction digits. Non-numeric values are shown as is

caption.description: Small muted line under the value, e.g. a due date. String, template or localized map

emphasis.description: variant list only: bold line set off by a rule, for a grand total

icon.description: variant cards only: icon in a tinted tile, e.g. tabler-package. May be a template

color.description: variant cards only: tint of the icon tile

variant.description: row: value over label, side by side. list: label left, value right, one per line. cards: a wrapping strip of equal cards with icon, label, value and caption

size.description: lg makes the value a headline figure with its label above it, e.g. the amount due in a card header

align.description: end aligns a row to the right edge

className.description: Extra CSS classes on the container
